notes_for_editor: Identity rests on the name alone. The Iowa Environmental Mesonet station GORUM FIRE TOWER (LACLIMATE, 1953-11-01 to 2012-02-22) has a point at 31.43580, -92.88270 and an elevation of 93.6 m. The OpenStreetMap tower node is at 31.4175016, -92.8999028 with ele 111. By our own arithmetic on those two coordinates the points are roughly 2.6 km apart; no source says which one marks the lookout. No source gives a build date, staffing, owner, or current status (record status: unknown). The Wikipedia Louisiana list, which says it is incomplete, does not name Gorum. The 2012 Louisiana chapter report (https://firelookout.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/cr-la-2012.pdf) describes an Aermotor tower moved from the LDAF headquarters at Natchitoches to the Southern Forest Heritage Museum; it does not name Gorum and is not used. The OSM changeset comment is the generic 'Add/modify towers.' Towerdex pages (towerdex.com/tower/1261223) return HTTP 403 to the fetcher and were not read.
